highlights.title: The sales step waits for your answer
highlights.text: In a ready-made Sales team, "Tell the team what you sell" is ticked only once you say it: a line starting "What we sell:" with your answer. A first question or a suggested prompt no longer ticks it.

highlights.title: Undo a ready-made team, then make it again
highlights.text: After you undo a ready-made team, its tile comes straight back without reloading. If its handle is already taken, the sheet says so and suggests a free one before you press Create.

fixes: Renaming a bot or the team handle before creating a ready-made team now reaches its instructions, skills and routine too.
When a teammate's reply hands over to another bot, its words keep their author's name until the next bot starts.
